title: Modern
subtitle: The reference palette, four pixels rounder than the default
description: The appearance this project has shipped with, and the one every screenshot before themes
were themeable was taken in. Nothing in this chapter is new.
It is the baseline the rest are read against, and it is also the one theme that states all
forty-one of its colours rather than inheriting any -- so what you see here is what every
Look at the node borders: an available node's ring is the same colour as the word
'available' beside a quest, and a locked node's outline is deliberately dimmer than the
word 'blocked'. Those became separate values this round, and both of those relationships
This chapter is also where the default theme is easiest to see the difference from, because
they share a palette and differ in exactly one value: the corners. Your book is the default,
which is square. Open a quest in this chapter and the overlay's panel is rounded by four
pixels; do the same in Vanilla Plus and it is square again. Same colours throughout -- the
default and Modern are the same palette -- so the corners are the only thing moving.
